product_one_liner.value: Quantum Metric captures and analyzes digital customer experiences so business, technology, and analytics teams can detect friction, diagnose issues, and prioritize improvements by business impact.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes custom plans but does not publish prices.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn gives the 201–500 company-size band; Quantum Metric’s story page also describes its workforce as 500+, so the exact band is uncertain.

eng_blog.notes: Skyler Bailey is identified as a Senior Solutions Engineer and authored technical posts about connecting experience data to a coding agent and the design of Quantum Metric’s MCP server.

public_docs.notes: Quantum Metric University publicly lists multiple product guides across Felix AI, the platform, and Voice of Customer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current openings list includes account executives, solutions engineers, and a strategy role, but no AI, ML, or data-science role title.

model_provider.value: Google Gemini (Gemini Pro for Felix AI Summarization)
model_provider.notes: The company says Felix Agentic uses Google Gemini and its summarization feature uses Gemini Pro.

compliance_certs.notes: The page claims SOC 2 attestation, ISO 27001 certification, and GDPR compliance; it mentions PCI and HIPAA as obligations customers may maintain, not as Quantum Metric certifications.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round found was the January 2021 Series B, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers page lists Enterprise Account Executive openings, including a live posting.

launched_6mo.notes: Quantum Metric announced the general availability of Quantum Metric MCP in October 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The dated executive-movements page reports a CMO and a VP-level marketing leader leaving in April 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Quantum Metric job posting names these systems in its description of modern marketing technology stacks.
